name: altinkaya-mcp
description: Search, filter and compare Altınkaya electronic enclosures and get their CAD files.
long_description: Gives Claude the Altınkaya electronic enclosure catalog: keyword search, parametric filtering by outer size, IP rating, material and category, side-by-side comparison, and links to drawings, DXF, STEP models, IP certificates and machining templates. Runs locally and read-only; no account or API key needed. Unofficial community project.

tools.name: search_enclosures
tools.description: Keyword search across the enclosure catalog

tools.name: filter_enclosures
tools.description: Filter by outer size, IP rating, material and category

tools.name: get_enclosure
tools.description: Full details, variants and documents for one enclosure

tools.name: get_cad_files
tools.description: Drawing, DXF, STEP and template download links

prompts.name: select_enclosure
prompts.text: Help me choose an Altınkaya enclosure for: ${arguments.contents}. Environment: ${arguments.environment}.
